# Rules

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A rule's namespace is the preset that turns it on: `stimulus/...` comes with
`/stimulus`, `browser/...` with `/browser`, and so on. A rule with no namespace
comes with `/base`.

Each rule links to its source, where a header comment explains what it is for and
why it exists.

| Rule | Preset | Fix | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`boolean-naming`](../src/rules/boolean_naming.js) | `/base` |  | Require boolean-returning methods to read as predicates (is/has prefix or a verb) |
| [`class-matches-file`](../src/rules/class_matches_file.js) | `/base` |  | Require a file that exports a class to be named after it |
| [`collapse-multi-line`](../src/rules/collapse_multi_line.js) | `/base` | yes | Collapse multi-line lists (params, args, objects, arrays, imports) when they fit on one line |
| [`compact-guard-clause`](../src/rules/compact_guard_clause.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer compact single-line guard clauses when they fit on one line |
| [`constant-naming`](../src/rules/constant_naming.js) | `/base` | yes | Require SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for module-level literal constants |
| [`declarative-method-naming`](../src/rules/declarative_method_naming.js) | `/base` |  | Name value-returning methods declaratively, not for the imperative action |
| [`inline-memoized-computation`](../src/rules/inline_memoized_computation.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow memoization that delegates to another no-argument private method |
| [`max-bare-returns`](../src/rules/max_bare_returns.js) | `/base` |  | Limit bare `return` (valueless) statements per function |
| [`max-comment-lines`](../src/rules/max_comment_lines.js) | `/base` |  | Limit how many lines a comment block spans |
| [`max-field-assignments`](../src/rules/max_field_assignments.js) | `/base` |  | Limit plain instance-field assignments in a private method |
| [`max-local-variables`](../src/rules/max_local_variables.js) | `/base` |  | Limit local variable declarations per function; extract methods instead |
| [`max-logical-operators-per-condition`](../src/rules/max_logical_operators_per_condition.js) | `/base` |  | Limit logical operators in conditions; extract complex predicates |
| [`max-optional-chain-depth`](../src/rules/max_optional_chain_depth.js) | `/base` |  | Limit optional-chain depth (`a?.b?.c?.d`) |
| [`max-validation-guards-per-function`](../src/rules/max_validation_guards_per_function.js) | `/base` |  | Limit validation guards (returning null/false/undefined) at the start of a function |
| [`no-anemic-delegation`](../src/rules/no_anemic_delegation.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow functions or private methods that only delegate to a freshly built object |
| [`no-anemic-record`](../src/rules/no_anemic_record.js) | `/base` |  | Detect an object literal of several fields read across functions; prefer a class |
| [`no-boolean-handler-chain`](../src/rules/no_boolean_handler_chain.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow boolean-returning handler chains (`a() \|\| b() \|\| c()`) |
| [`no-data-clump`](../src/rules/no_data_clump.js) | `/base` |  | Detect argument names that travel together across functions; prefer a class holding them |
| [`no-effectful-bare-return`](../src/rules/no_effectful_bare_return.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow a bare `return` at the end of a branch that first does other work |
| [`no-handler-prefix`](../src/rules/no_handler_prefix.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow the `handle` name prefix; name for the action, not the event |
| [`no-jsdoc`](../src/rules/no_jsdoc.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow JSDoc block comments |
| [`no-local-variable-return`](../src/rules/no_local_variable_return.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow returning a local variable as a function's last statement |
| [`no-manual-accumulation`](../src/rules/no_manual_accumulation.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer declarative array/object/Map building over manual loop or forEach accumulation |
| [`no-method-named-call`](../src/rules/no_method_named_call.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow defining a method or function named `call` |
| [`no-mid-function-returns`](../src/rules/no_mid_function_returns.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `return`/`throw` outside the leading guard zone or final statement |
| [`no-mixed-exports`](../src/rules/no_mixed_exports.js) | `/base` |  | Require a file's exports to be one kind of thing, with an exported class standing alone |
| [`no-mixed-memoization`](../src/rules/no_mixed_memoization.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow mixing memoization with other statements in the same method |
| [`no-mutable-module-scope`](../src/rules/no_mutable_module_scope.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `let`/`var` declarations at module scope |
| [`no-padded-braces`](../src/rules/no_padded_braces.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow blank lines after `{` or before `}` in imports, exports, objects, and destructuring |
| [`no-redundant-bind-after-arrow`](../src/rules/no_redundant_bind_after_arrow.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `this.foo.bind(this)` when `foo` is an arrow class field |
| [`no-redundant-trailing-return`](../src/rules/no_redundant_trailing_return.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow trailing bare or undefined returns in side-effect-only functions |
| [`no-redundant-wrapper`](../src/rules/no_redundant_wrapper.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow private methods, getters or module functions that only forward a call or constant |
| [`no-relative-imports`](../src/rules/no_relative_imports.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow relative imports when an equivalent bare import resolves |
| [`no-section-divider-comments`](../src/rules/no_section_divider_comments.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow ASCII-art section divider comments |
| [`no-typographic-clutter`](../src/rules/no_typographic_clutter.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow typographic clutter: invisible marks anywhere, smart quotes and dashes in prose |
| [`no-uninitialized-field`](../src/rules/no_uninitialized_field.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow a class field declared without a value |
| [`padding-after-guard-clause`](../src/rules/padding_after_guard_clause.js) | `/base` | yes | Require a blank line after guard clauses |
| [`prefer-array-from-mapping`](../src/rules/prefer_array_from_mapping.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `Array.from(x, fn)` over mapping the array `Array.from(x)` or `[ ...x ]` builds |
| [`prefer-arrow-handler-field`](../src/rules/prefer_arrow_handler_field.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer arrow class fields over `this.foo = this.foo.bind(this)` |
| [`prefer-class-for-state`](../src/rules/prefer_class_for_state.js) | `/base` |  | Detect a value threaded through many functions; prefer a class holding it as state |
| [`prefer-constant`](../src/rules/prefer_constant.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow functions whose body only returns a fixed literal; name them as constants |
| [`prefer-find-over-loop`](../src/rules/prefer_find_over_loop.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer `.find()`/`.some()` over a `for...of` that conditionally returns a value |
| [`prefer-for-each`](../src/rules/prefer_for_each.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `.forEach()` over `for...of` for pure compatible collection iteration |
| [`prefer-function-over-stateless-method`](../src/rules/prefer_function_over_stateless_method.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow private methods that never use `this`; make them module-level functions |
| [`prefer-field-over-accessor`](../src/rules/prefer_field_over_accessor.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a public field over accessors that only relay the private field of the same name |
| [`prefer-getter`](../src/rules/prefer_getter.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a getter over a parameterless method that only returns a value |
| [`prefer-getter-over-local`](../src/rules/prefer_getter_over_local.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a memoized getter over a local that reuses class state in a class method |
| [`prefer-minimal-ternary`](../src/rules/prefer_minimal_ternary.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a ternary around the part that varies over one around the whole expression |
| [`prefer-positive-wrap`](../src/rules/prefer_positive_wrap.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer wrapping a happy path positively over a leading negative guard |
| [`prefer-private-member`](../src/rules/prefer_private_member.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow public class members that only their own class reads |
| [`prefer-switch-over-if-chain`](../src/rules/prefer_switch_over_if_chain.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `switch` over `if/else if` chains comparing the same subject |
| [`prefer-tail-condition`](../src/rules/prefer_tail_condition.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `if (!condition) return X` over `if (condition) return; return X` at the tail of a block |
| [`prefer-ternary-return`](../src/rules/prefer_ternary_return.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer a single return expression over `if (condition) return X; return Y` |
| [`reflow-comments`](../src/rules/reflow_comments.js) | `/base` | yes | Fill a comment wrapped short of the max width when the break falls mid-sentence |
| [`step-down-methods`](../src/rules/step_down_methods.js) | `/base` | yes | Order methods within each class group top-down: a caller before its callees |
| [`step-down-top-level`](../src/rules/step_down_top_level.js) | `/base` | yes | Order top-level functions and classes top-down: callers before callees, exported first |
| [`test-structure`](../src/rules/test_structure.js) | `/base` |  | Require flat `test` calls with setup and teardown hooks ordered before tests |
| [`top-level-constants-first`](../src/rules/top_level_constants_first.js) | `/base` | yes | Group module-level const declarations at the top, before functions and classes |
| [`unnecessary-local-variable`](../src/rules/unnecessary_local_variable.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow a local variable that aliases a call used only once |
| [`vertical-spacing`](../src/rules/vertical_spacing.js) | `/base` | yes | Surround code with blank lines; group same-category data without them |
| [`browser/html-element-suffix`](../src/rules/browser/html_element_suffix.js) | `/browser` |  | Require classes extending HTMLElement to end in `Element` |
| [`browser/no-class-selector`](../src/rules/browser/no_class_selector.js) | `/browser` |  | Disallow selecting DOM nodes by CSS class; classes style, they do not carry state |
| [`browser/prefer-reflected-aria-properties`](../src/rules/browser/prefer_reflected_aria_properties.js) | `/browser` | yes | Prefer reflected ARIA properties over `aria-*` attribute calls |
| [`browser/query-selector-suffix`](../src/rules/browser/query_selector_suffix.js) | `/browser` |  | Require getters returning querySelector(All) results to end in Element/Elements |
| [`rails/no-manual-csrf`](../src/rules/rails/no_manual_csrf.js) | `/rails` |  | Disallow manual CSRF meta, header, and authenticity_token field access |
| [`restrictions/exports`](../src/rules/restrictions/exports.js) | `/restrictions` |  | Restrict which kinds of thing a file may export |
| [`stimulus/action-naming`](../src/rules/stimulus/action_naming.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow the `on` prefix on Stimulus controller actions |
| [`stimulus/controller-shape`](../src/rules/stimulus/controller_shape.js) | `/stimulus` | yes | Enforce Stimulus controller member order |
| [`stimulus/no-imperative-event-listener`](../src/rules/stimulus/no_imperative_event_listener.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow `addEventListener` in Stimulus controllers; use `data-action` in HTML |
| [`stimulus/no-instance-state-assignment`](../src/rules/stimulus/no_instance_state_assignment.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow public `this.foo = ...` in Stimulus controllers; use `#private` or declare a value |
| [`stimulus/no-manual-static-attribute-query`](../src/rules/stimulus/no_manual_static_attribute_query.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow querying Stimulus wiring attributes by hand |
| [`stimulus/prefer-dispatch`](../src/rules/stimulus/prefer_dispatch.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Prefer `this.dispatch(...)` over `this.element.dispatchEvent(...)` in Stimulus controllers |
| [`stimulus/static-config-keys-camelcase`](../src/rules/stimulus/static_config_keys_camelcase.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Enforce Stimulus naming conventions in static configuration |
| [`stimulus/use-has-target-getter`](../src/rules/stimulus/use_has_target_getter.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Prefer the `hasFooTarget` getter over comparing `this.fooTargets.length` |
| [`turbo/no-render-stream-message`](../src/rules/turbo/no_render_stream_message.js) | `/turbo` |  | Disallow Turbo.renderStreamMessage; let the server drive Turbo Streams |
| [`turbo/no-stream-accept-header`](../src/rules/turbo/no_stream_accept_header.js) | `/turbo` |  | Disallow requesting Turbo Streams from JS via the Accept header |
